Question 4
?

Expressed in terms of common logarithms, what value of x satisfies the equation 10x−3=7x?

a
1−log⁡(7)
b
3log⁡(7)
c
−3log⁡(7)
d
31−log⁡(7)
e
11+2log⁡(7)
